description: Source code for the SimpleWorker class implementing job processing logic in Mattermost, including job execution, status updates, and error handling.

classes.name: SimpleWorker
classes.description: A worker class that processes jobs asynchronously, manages job lifecycle, and logs progress.

methods.name: NewSimpleWorker
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new SimpleWorker instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker's main loop to process jobs and listen for stop signals.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Signals the worker to stop processing jobs.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel for submitting jobs to the worker.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the worker is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Executes a given job, handling claiming, execution, and error management.

methods.name: setJobSuccess
methods.description: Updates the job status to success and progress to 100%.

methods.name: setJobError
methods.description: Sets an error state for the job.
